The agent did not perform a comprehensive search of the entire NeurIPS 2022 conference proceedings to ensure no other papers by authors named "Yuri" (e.g., Yuri Saporito, Yuri Fonseca, or others) were missed. This behavior aligns with the "Premature Conclusion" and "Assumption-Based Error" patterns seen in Example 9, where the agent assumes the data is complete without cross-verification or exhaustive searching. The ground truth provided in the prompt (3 papers) confirms that the agent's conclusion was factually incorrect due to this lack of thoroughness.
